scope: One authored mixed-corpus sanity check, not an independent retrieval benchmark or RAG benefit study.
label_source: examples/history_dialogues/manifest.json; labels not used during extraction/indexing/search
query:
Upgrade WineService from the centroid classifier to sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier for the UCI Wine classification service.
Implement actual training and inference; set the default algorithm in config.json to random_forest. Keep WineService(algorithm=None), fit(X,y)->self and predict(X)->list[dict] compatible. Each result must have an integer label, float confidence in [0,1], and metadata.algorithm plus a nonempty metadata.reason. Keep algorithm='centroid' as an explicit fallback with identical predictions and confidences to the original service.
Use only the caller-supplied training data in fit. Do not read holdout labels or hard-code predictions. Preserve input ordering, return [] for empty predict input, and reject wrong feature counts or non-finite inputs with ValueError. The fixed validator checks actual RandomForest fit and predict_proba calls, interface signatures, output types, holdout balanced accuracy >= max(0.95, baseline balanced accuracy minus 0.02), batch/single-row consistency, determinism and legacy fallback. Use random_state=42 and n_jobs=1 for reproducibility.
Only edit service.py and config.json through write_file actions. Do not modify the validator, data or any other files. There is no prescribed number of attempts: deliver if independent validation passes; otherwise use actual failures to revise the implementation.
